# Welcome to Stockholm

![](https://images.teamtailor-cdn.com/images/s3/teamtailor-production/user_picture_1200-v8/image_uploads/73a7eb77-5869-4811-aa99-186c0f20657b/original.jpeg)

## Our HQ

Our Stockholm office is centrally located at Klarabergsgatan 29 with four floors. We have a lot of social areas such as ping-pong and pool tables, a gaming room, a library, a music room with instruments, a patio for summer after work, and a lunch area with a bar and snacks and drinks.

In Stockholm, we are about 220 people and have all departments working divided on 3 floors. Continue scrolling to learn more about our Stockholm office.

## A selection of perks and benefits

- ### Pension Program




For most roles at Funnel, we offer an ITP 1 pension match.

- ### Insurance Package




This includes Work Accident Insurance (TFA), Sickness Insurance, Private Medical Insurance, and Group Life Insurance (TGL).

- ### Vacation




All employees in Sweden have 30 days of paid vacation days.

- ### Wellness Allowance




We offer a 5000 SEK wellness allowance.

- ### Stock Option Program




Our employees are important stakeholders of Funnel’s and we want to invest in our employees.

- ### Parental Leave Top-Up




The parental leave salary amounts to 90% of the employee's monthly salary (with a maximum).
